listing.name: Phase Ship Config
listing.summary: Adds a lunaconfig menu that allows you to: Nerf the armor, hull, and speed of phase ships (ships with phase-like systems and phase fighters optionally).
listing.aiSummary: Lets you nerf or buff the armor, hull, and speed of phase ships and adjust their flux-based slowdown threshold via a configuration menu.

description: Provides a LunaConfig menu to modify the armor, hull, and speed of phase ships, including those with phase-like systems. It also allows adjusting the maximum-slowdown hard-flux threshold, which can be set high enough to effectively remove all flux-based slowdown.

changelog.1.0.2: When "Phase Slowdown Threshold Percent" is set to 500 there is now a speed and acceleration bonus (or malus) to phase ships to account for any intended (and now obsolete) change to their threshold from skills or hullmods. (e.g. Adaptive Phase Coils will grant 10% extra speed and 20% extra acceleration while the ship is phasing).
changelog.1.0.1:
Added a setting to configure the maximum-slowdown hard-flux threshold. This can be set so far beyond 100% flux that it effectively disables all slowdown.
 The speed, armor, and hull changes will now affect ships that have phase-like ship systems. Added a toggle to keep excluding the aforementioned ship type.
